message.content: No, I can’t. The airspace desk only handles the shared airspace data—closures, zones, corridors—that applies to all companies. We don’t track individual flights, drones, or which company they belong to. If a company wants to know how a closure messed up *their* operations, they’d have to ask their own operations team or look at their own logs. Our job is just to make sure everyone has the same picture of where they *can’t* fly.
